page.overview:
Who is Gravitator?

Chris, also known as Gravitator, is a minor character in Invincible, debuting in Season 5. He is the fiancée of Hanna.

Chris is an ordinary human male of average height and build with short brown hair and brown eyes. Lacking natural superhuman physical mutations, his appearance is defined by the high-tech, mechanical gravity-distorting exo-suit and custom gravity gun he constructed out of stolen factory components. He looks like a standard scientist or technician rather than a traditional comic book villain, relying entirely on his wearable technology to manipulate gravitational fields.

Chris dons a bulky, mechanical makeshift exo-suit. Constructed entirely from stolen industrial spare parts and factory components, the heavy-duty harness has a raw, blue-collar aesthetic featuring exposed wiring and metallic plating rather than a sleek supervillain design. His look is defined by this wearable technology, specifically the custom-engineered gravity gun wired directly into his gauntlets that serves as his primary weapon for projecting concentrated bursts of localized anti-gravity energy.
